اصطنعن (form VIII)
# اِصْطَنَعْنَ (iṣṭanaʕna) /isˤ.tˤa.naʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# اُصْطُنِعْنَ (uṣṭuniʕna) /usˤ.tˤu.niʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
# اِصْطَنِعْنَ (iṣṭaniʕna) /isˤ.tˤa.niʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِصْطَنَعَ (iṣṭanaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
